userStories.title: Strip script tags from HTML response bodies
userStories.description: As a security reviewer, I want <script> tag content removed from captured HTTP response bodies before the body is wrapped and shown to the model, so injected scripts cannot reach the model as executable instructions.

Apply stripping inside scrub_and_wrap_body (or a new helper called from it) in dynamic_http.py, before the <target_content> wrap
Use re.sub(r'<script[^>]*>.*?</script>', '', body, flags=re.DOTALL) — no new HTML-parsing dependency
Secret scrubbing and the body cap still execute in the correct order after this change
